decisive_spans.text: Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei

response.rationale: D3 (Neurofibroma) is strongly supported by the positive S100 staining and the description of a hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells, which is characteristic of neurofibromas. D5 (Neuroepithelial tumor) is also supported by positive S100 and patchy positive GFAP, but the specific histological description aligns more closely with Neurofibroma. D1 (Medulloepithelioma) is contradicted by the absence of malignant cells and epithelial components. D6 (Glial choristoma) is less specific than D3 given the detailed histological findings.
